purpose: Fixed event-specific descriptive comparison of ten preserved U records in at most two newly header-selected archival epochs per target.
selection_rule: For HD122640 then HD135204, choose minimum then maximum recorded BERV from PASS_RECORDED_BERV header results; equal-BERV ties lexicographically smallest dp_id; deduplicate same dp_id. No new flux enters selection.
expected_profile_slots: 2 * (6 * selected_HD122640_epochs + 4 * selected_HD135204_epochs); all selected slots retained including failures.

frames.barycentric: Fixed accepted fitted center in barycentric air wavelengths; not corrected for stellar radial velocity.
frames.topocentric: Fixed accepted center divided by(1+BERV_discovery/c); each comparison queried at(center_top+x)*(1+BERV_epoch/c),c=299792.458km/s. Classical approximation, no full relativistic/drift correction.

sampling.interpolation: Linear within measured coverage; mask bracket gaps exceeding1.51times median input wavelength step; no extrapolation.
sampling.normalization: Median finite original flux within±2Å of frame-specific requested barycentric center; must be positive. Retain unusable records.
sampling.background: Unweighted least-squares constant+slope on fixed |offset|>=0.60Å sidebands, minimum20 finite points.
sampling.correlation: Pearson zero-shift correlation of residual profiles within|offset|<=0.25Å,minimum20 finite shared points. No shift or center optimization.
sampling.line_fits: Unweighted constant+slope+signed unit-height Gaussian at fixed center and FWHM=center/115000,or3times that width; use|offset|<=0.25Å. Report amplitudes/RMS,not SNR.
sampling.noise: First-difference1.4826MAD/sqrt2 within±2Å is descriptive proxy only; flag normalization<=3proxy as low reference continuum; no formal errors if ERR unavailable.

implementation: Import verified original epoch_followup/measure_epochs.py and call its profile,corr,stats functions without modification or main execution. Reuse the two separately archived discovery residual arrays for each event.
representation_gate: Exactly one raw progenitor distinct from all existing exposures and other selected products; exact DP,target,date,position,exptime,BERV from preserved primary header inspection.
SPECSYS=BARYCENT; SPEC_RES=115000; ESO INS HEFS ST is explicit False. Actual INS MODE retained; HARPS+NIRPS is not interpreted as EGGS or rejected merely by string.
Exactly one spectral table row with WAVE,FLUX,ERR columns; WAVE units angstrom and UCD containing obs.atmos; FLUX units ADU. No silent air/vacuum or wavelength-unit conversion.
All payload headers checked before any new .data access. Finite strictly increasing wavelength and matching1D arrays then required; no sorting/regridding adaptation beyond inherited interpolation.
Pipeline version differences from HARPS_3.8 retained as context; no new instrumental response, drift, stellar-RV or line-spread correction is fitted.

release_contract.paths: Repository-relative for release-linked files and input payloads/receipts; header-body/receipt paths are relative to HEADER_RESULTS parent directory.
release_contract.selection: Header-owner EXTREME_SELECTION.json with selected list, agreed job/hash fields and header_results_sha256.
release_contract.acquisition_manifest: Canonical JSON with inputs list exactly equal release.inputs; every selected identity appears in the same order including failed slots.
release_contract.execution: No network; refuses without SHA-tied root release and refuses any pre-existing results directory.

limitations: Post-detection selection biases all estimates. Metrics do not independently validate a signal or determine its origin.
Barycentric coherence may describe absorption/emission blends or instrumental structure; no stellar-rest-frame identity follows.
Topocentric coherence is not proof of terrestrial origin.
Multiple hit records and nearby centers are correlated and cannot be counted as independent phenomena.
Temporal repeats are archival exposures,not independent new telescope observations.
No significance calibration,survey completeness,physical line flux,or extraterrestrial claim.
New epochs are archival observations, not observations commissioned by this project; records and nearby event centers remain correlated.
New BERV range alone does not identify physical origin or give a sensitivity/false-alarm calibration.
Instrument era, pipeline, extraction/blaze/background, line-spread function and wavelength zero-point may differ even when nominal units/resolution match.
Original discovery ERR samples are unavailable; inherited fits are unweighted and errors are descriptive only, even if a new product supplies positive errors.
Signed Gaussian widths are fixed templates, not measured linewidths. Normalized amplitudes are not calibrated fluxes or significance.
Barycentric wavelengths are not a stellar rest frame; stellar radial-velocity changes remain a potential confounder.
Partial/missing/incompatible products remain explicit blocked selected slots; no replacement target or epoch is chosen from flux outcomes.
